question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

A loud thud woke up everybody and nobody knew what all the ______ was about.
solution:
The correct answer is "**commotion**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the given sentence, it is mentioned that the loud noise woke everyone up and nobody knew what the ruckus was about.**
 
• **Now, among the given options, the correct word to use is "commotion."**
 
 
• **"Commotion" means a state of confused and noisy disturbance.**(हंगामा)
 
• Example: The commotion outside the window woke me up from my sleep.
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank as it fits the context of the sentence.
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be:
 
 
• A loud thud woke up everybody and nobody knew what all the commotion__ was about.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (exoneration) means the act of clearing someone of blame or accusation.(दोषमुक्ति)
 
• Option 3 (abomination) means something that causes disgust or hatred. (नफरत)
 
• Option 4 (culmination) means the highest point or climax of something. (परिणति)
